title: Touchline Physical Character V2 specification (design, not runtime)
coordinate: CCS +X anatomical right, +Y up, +Z forward (left-handed, Unity numeric); metres, kg, s, rad

flex(+)/ext(-): Troke 2005 young: flex 73 / ext 29 [H]; ENG split of thoracolumbar total

axial rot: recalled; 73 % of it at C1-C2 (Zhou 2020) [H] -> render split

joints.name: shoulder
joints.anat: glenohumeral + shoulder girdle (lumped; centre fixed in thorax)

joints.name: hip

flex(+)/ext(-): Soucie 2011 flex 130.4 (p95 142) / ext 17.4 passive; Roaas ext 9.4 prone [H]
IR(+)/ER(-): pro soccer IR 28.9, total 65.6 (Tak 2016); sitting active 44 / 44 [H]

joints.pose: hamstrings: straight-leg hip flexion ~70-90 deg (passive torque grows with knee extension) [recalled]; rotation range changes with flexion (Han 2015, Simoneau 1998) [H]

joints.name: knee

tibial IR(+)/ER(-): ~0 at full extension, tens of degrees at 90 deg flexion (recalled)

joints.pose: axial rotation stiffened near extension (screw-home) by passive torque [ENG]

joints.name: ankle

DF(+)/PF(-): Soucie 2011 DF 12.7 (knee ext, NWB) / PF 54.6; knee-bent DF 40.5 (Cho 2016); WB lunge 38.8-43.2 [H]

joints.pose: dorsiflexion limit grows with knee flexion (gastrocnemius): ~20 knee straight -> ~40 knee bent [H]

pelvis.evidence: hip breadth 0.19-0.197 H (Drillis / ANSUR II); depth 0.125 H; extends 7 cm below the HJC (gluteal)

abdomen.evidence: waist depth 0.119 H (ANSUR II footballer-sized subset 215 mm); breadth ENG 0.155 H (arm clearance at 6 deg abduction)

thorax.evidence: chest depth 0.131 H (ANSUR subset 237 mm); breadth 0.165 H (< Drillis external chest 0.174 H)

head.shape: AP sphere pair + neck capsule (collision representation C4, 2026-10-03; dimensions of the C1 AP capsule)
head.evidence: head length 0.114 H, breadth 0.088 H (ANSUR II): r = breadth / 2, sphere centres at +/-(length - breadth) / 2 along AP -> AP extent = length, breadth = 2r (3.7 mm waist at the sides, inside the -15..+5 mm head tolerance). C1 chose an AP capsule; G1 showed Jolt's capsule face heuristic rests its end cap up to 7.5 mm into the turf; C4 keeps the dimensions with two spheres

upperArm.evidence: bideltoid 0.291 H (ANSUR II) reproduced; capsule volume-matched (de Leva mass / Dempster density 1070)

forearm.evidence: volume-matched (density 1130); hand capsule on the forearm body (core)

thigh.axis: from 0.02 m lateral / 0.05 m below the HJC to 0.02 m above the KJC
thigh.evidence: girth-based (proximal thigh circumference ~0.30 H); a volume match gives ~0.10 m and overlaps the opposite thigh

foot.shape: convexHull (boot); collision representation D1a (2026-10-03): 10 convex pieces tiling the hull (grid AP 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 x ML 0.5), hull tolerance 1e-5 m, identical external geometry and mass properties

actuators.dyn_evidence: sprint initial swing (Schache 2011); kicks 194-309 N.m (Kellis & Katis 2007)

actuators.iso_evidence: Anderson 2007 2.76 @53 deg flex; Anderson & Madigan 2014 4.51 @68 deg
soccer 60 deg/s concentric 3.1-3.4 (Fousekis 2010) / f(60 deg/s)=0.85; Sarabon 2021 3.19
Maciel 2022 34.8 N.m at 30 deg/s (mixed sex, 38 y) -> athlete ENG
